### Three-Day Local Draft Project Plan

**Total workload:** 8 hours  
**Daily limit:** Maximum 3 hours/day

| Day | Task | Time | Dependencies | Output |
|---|---|---:|---|---|
| Day 1 | Research | 2 hours | None | Gather sources, notes, key points, and supporting material |
| Day 1 | Research organization / prep | 1 hour | Research in progress or completed | Clean notes and identify main themes |
| Day 2 | Outline | 1 hour | Research complete | Draft structure, sections, arguments, and flow |
| Day 2 | Writing (Part 1) | 2 hours | Outline completed | First draft of initial sections |
| Day 3 | Writing (Part 2) | 1 hour | Writing Part 1 completed | Complete remaining draft sections |
| Day 3 | Review | 2 hours | Full draft completed | Edit for clarity, accuracy, structure, and final improvements |

### Dependency Flow

```
Research (2h)
      ↓
Research Organization (1h)
      ↓
Outline (1h)
      ↓
Writing Part 1 (2h)
      ↓
Writing Part 2 (1h)
      ↓
Review (2h)
```

### Daily Time Check

- **Day 1:** 3 hours  
- **Day 2:** 3 hours  
- **Day 3:** 3 hours  

All days stay within the 3-hour maximum.
